Cornell Engineering Handbook Fall 2026, Major: Chemical Engineering p. 52 (https://cornellengineeringhandbook.freeflowdp.com/cornellengineeringhandbook/fall_2026/data/fall26-dl.pdf); same list as Courses of Study 2026-27 PDF https://courses.cornell.edu/programs/chemical-engineering-bs/chemical-engineering-bs.pdf

advanced: Six credits of Advanced Chemical Engineering Electives chosen from this list.
Three one-credit modules associated with CHEME 6660 may be combined to satisfy one Advanced Chemical Engineering Elective.
Advanced CHEME electives must be satisfied by specifically approved CHEME courses. (Courses of Study 2026-27)
majorApproved: Three of the Major-approved Electives, minimum of 9 credits, are intended to build on the foundation of fundamentals taken in one's first two years.
Major-approved electives are usually advanced technical courses, at level 3000 and above although ENGRD 2700, CS 2800 and similar courses are appropriate.
The Major-approved electives are technical or professionally oriented courses approved by your chemical & biomolecular engineering advisor.
biology: "Each student must complete one of the seven following options for the biology elective" (note f).
The biology elective can be taken when schedule permits.
advisor: CHEM 2080 & CHEM 2081 (CHEM 2150) fulfills one of the two Advisor-approved Elective credits. (Courses of Study 2026-27, note 1)

examCredit.why: The Engineering exam table's id for AP Biology 5, A-Level Biology B/A/A*, IB Biology HL 7 and Pre-U Biology (8 credits).

multiCourseNotChecked: BIOG 1500 + BIOMG 1350 + (BIOG 1440 or BIOG 1445): Eight credits of a pre-med biology sequence; 2025 handbook also allows BIOG 1107 + BIOG 1108 (summer) + BIOG 1500
BIOMG 3310 + BIOMG 3320: Five credits of biochemistry (3 + 2)

majorApproved.why: Engineering, math, science and biology at 3000+ with 3+ credits (the seat's minimum), plus the two 2000-level courses the catalog names. Advisors may approve other technical or professionally oriented courses.
